title: Chart axis starts at 0, and extends below 0 only for negative values
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as an owner/admin (or any user with the Reports permission) on the build under test; a single workplace is selected.
  2. A chart expanded (e.g. a KPI tile’s chart via View details); seed data so the selected range has all-positive values, and separately a range where at least one drawn value is below 0 (e.g. Revenue negative because credit memos exceed sales).
custom_steps:
1. Expand a chart whose values are all positive and read where the vertical axis begins.
2. View a dollar chart and a percentage chart and confirm each axis begins at 0.
3. Select a range where a drawn value is below 0 (e.g. Revenue negative from credit memos) and read the bottom of the axis.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Every chart’s vertical axis starts at 0 — on both percentage charts and dollar charts.
  • When a drawn value in the selected range is below 0, the axis extends below 0 far enough to show that value in full.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490, story SV-9581 (S9 — Chart Behavior); Dashboard v1 specification, Confluence page 788430850, section S9; read on 2 October 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-R8: “Every chart’s vertical axis starts at 0, on percentage charts and dollar charts alike. The one exception: when any drawn value in the selected range is below 0, the axis extends below 0 far enough to show that value in full. (@chris ruling, 2026-09-24.)”

Last checked against build v26.39.1-09be696 on 10/2/2026.
